title: Energy-Optimal Retrieval Depth in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
description: Research harness and decision-theoretic study of retrieval depth in retrieval-augmented generation. The release contains the P0-P4 experiment configurations, preregistration, registered run metadata, analysis outputs, paper sources, and reproducibility scripts. Raw SQuAD/HotpotQA text and raw run directories are not redistributed; the release publishes IDs, checksums, configs, prompts, predictions, and aggregate results.
notes: Published at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24352803. The external raw-data backup is recorded in docs/BACKUP.md; raw question/context text is not redistributed.
